diffs.patch:
Index: pom.xml
===================================================================
--- pom.xml	
+++ pom.xml	
@@ -0,0 +1,62 @@
+<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
+<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
+         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
+         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
+    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
+
+    <groupId>com.example</groupId>
+    <artifactId>boilerplate-free</artifactId>
+    <version>1.0.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
+    <packaging>jar</packaging>
+
+    <name>boilerplate-free</name>
+    <description>Maven project using Lombok to cut down on boilerplate</description>
+
+    <properties>
+        <maven.compiler.release>21</maven.compiler.release>
+        <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>
+        <lombok.version>1.18.48</lombok.version>
+        <junit.version>6.1.3</junit.version>
+    </properties>
+
+    <dependencies>
+        <dependency>
+            <groupId>org.projectlombok</groupId>
+            <artifactId>lombok</artifactId>
+            <version>${lombok.version}</version>
+            <scope>provided</scope>
+        </dependency>
+
+        <dependency>
+            <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
+            <artifactId>junit-jupiter</artifactId>
+            <version>${junit.version}</version>
+            <scope>test</scope>
+        </dependency>
+    </dependencies>
+
+    <build>
+        <plugins>
+            <plugin>
+                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
+                <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
+                <version>3.16.0</version>
+                <configuration>
+                    <annotationProcessorPaths>
+                        <path>
+                            <groupId>org.projectlombok</groupId>
+                            <artifactId>lombok</artifactId>
+                            <version>${lombok.version}</version>
+                        </path>
+                    </annotationProcessorPaths>
+                </configuration>
+            </plugin>
+
+            <plugin>
+                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
+                <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
+                <version>3.6.0</version>
+            </plugin>
+        </plugins>
+    </build>
+</project>

The working directory is a git repo with .opencode and opencode.json. Let me set up a new Maven project. Lombok is the obvious choice. But note Java 26 - Lombok compatibility might be an issue. Let me check. Actually Lombok latest versions support newer JDKs. Let me check what's available.

Let me create the project structure. I should decide on a reasonable setup. Let me create pom.xml with Lombok, a sample class using @Data, and make sure it compiles.

Java 26 is quite new. Lombok may not officially support it. Let me check maven repo for latest lombok. Let me just try. Actually, let me build and see.

Let me create the project. The directory root is /work and it's a git repo already. Should I create the project in /work directly or a subdirectory? The user says "Set up a new Maven Java project". The working directory is empty except config. I'll set it up in /work directly.

Let me create pom.xml.

input.content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

    <groupId>com.example</groupId>
    <artifactId>boilerplate-free</artifactId>
    <version>1.0.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
    <packaging>jar</packaging>

    <name>boilerplate-free</name>
    <description>Maven project using Lombok to cut down on boilerplate</description>

    <properties>
        <maven.compiler.release>21</maven.compiler.release>
        <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>
        <lombok.version>1.18.42</lombok.version>
        <junit.version>5.11.4</junit.version>
    </properties>

    <dependencies>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.projectlombok</groupId>
            <artifactId>lombok</artifactId>
            <version>${lombok.version}</version>
            <scope>provided</scope>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
            <artifactId>junit-jupiter</artifactId>
            <version>${junit.version}</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>

    <build>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.13.0</version>
                <configuration>
                    <annotationProcessorPaths>
                        <path>
                            <groupId>org.projectlombok</groupId>
                            <artifactId>lombok</artifactId>
                            <version>${lombok.version}</version>
                        </path>
                    </annotationProcessorPaths>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>

            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.5.2</version>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>
</project>

Done. Maven project set up with **Lombok** to eliminate boilerplate, verified with `mvn test` (2 tests pass, generated `ProductBuilder` confirms annotation processing works).

- `pom.xml` — Java 21 target, Lombok 1.18.48 (`provided` + annotation processor path), JUnit 6
- `src/main/java/com/example/boilerplate/Product.java` — `@Data` (getters/setters/`equals`/`hashCode`/`toString`), `@Builder`, `@NoArgsConstructor`, `@AllArgsConstructor`
- `src/test/java/com/example/boilerplate/ProductTest.java` — verifies generated builder/accessors
- `.gitignore`

Note: on JDK 26 Lombok emits a benign `sun.misc.Unsafe` deprecation warning; if it becomes an issue, pin the build to a JDK 21 toolchain. Want me to add a `maven-toolchains-plugin`/wrapper for that?
